checks_run.command: with-pg.sh 29321 pnpm vitest run --project integration apps/api/test/integration/zz-sec-r11-probe.test.ts   (clone 68fe3394, LANG unset)

checks_run.procedure: Run the same probe unchanged on this candidate in a disposable clone at 309aff2, on Node 22 with LANG unset and on Node 24 with LANG=C.UTF-8. Read connection-hygiene.ts, server.ts, main.ts, framework-errors.ts and evidence/routes.ts. Check the root-cause claim and the Node sources the fix relies on.
checks_run.command: with-pg.sh 29322 / 29323 pnpm vitest run --project integration apps/api/test/integration/zz-sec-r11-probe.test.ts; node -e 'process.binding("natives")._http_server / .net' (resOnFinish, destroySoon call sites)
checks_run.environment: Node 22.22.2 (LANG unset, SQL_ASCII cluster) and Node 24.21.0 (LANG=C.UTF-8, UTF8 cluster); disposable PostgreSQL 16; synthetic data
checks_run.expected: 413 with Connection: close and a bounded close; the socket released promptly after the client goes; app.close() prompt; refusals before the body is read close without draining
checks_run.actual:
Fix genuine: F-DG2-410 is CLOSED_VERIFIED in code-security-reviewer.verifications.json. Results are identical on both runs.
- R1: 413 with Connection: close. The server closes 128-284 ms after connect and releases the socket 479-507 ms after the client destroys it.
- R1c: app.close() takes 0-1 ms.
- R3: Connection: close, and the client gets only 0.1-0.9 MiB out.
- R2b: an over-limit body received in full gets 413, and the same connection then serves 200.
- Root cause confirmed in the code. Node 22/24 resOnFinish calls socket.destroySoon() only when res._last, and that is its only server call site.
Each probe run exits 1 by design: 14 passed, 3 failed. The failures are R6a and R6d (F-DG2-412) and R8 (F-DG2-411), both outside this fix. Neither log has 'Hook timed out' or 'Failed Suites'.

Read the diff for any change to those paths.
checks_run.command: zz-sec-r11-probe.test.ts R2, R2b, R7 (same runs as SEC-R11-01/02); git diff fe22d759..cbdb4f68 -- apps/api/src
checks_run.expected: 200 responses stay keep-alive and the socket serves further requests; the stored sha256 is that of the raw bytes; every refusal is unchanged

checks_run.procedure: Probe R5, with grace 3 s: an idle keep-alive socket, an upload that finishes in about 1.5 s, and a stalled upload, then app.close(). Read the preClose hook, the main.ts backstop and the lingerOnClose override and its fallback against Node's net.Socket.destroySoon. Check the candidate's SIGTERM test.
checks_run.command: zz-sec-r11-probe.test.ts R5; connection-hygiene.test.ts 'shutdown is bounded' (integration runs)
checks_run.expected: Idle sockets are closed at once. In-flight requests that finish within the grace complete normally, with Connection: close. Stalled ones are cut at the grace. The override is used only for the sockets that close, and is safe.
checks_run.actual:
R5 (both runs): the idle socket closes 0-1 ms after close() starts. The finishing upload gets 200 with Connection: close and is stored byte-exact. The stalled socket is closed at 3,001-3,002 ms, and app.close() returns at 3,001-3,002 ms.
The lingerOnClose override is per-socket and idempotent. Node calls destroySoon only from resOnFinish under res._last. The override replicates Node's end() and adds a 500 ms delay after flush with a 2 s cap. Its timers are unref'd, and the cap is cleared on 'close'. A socket without destroySoon is left to Node's socket.end().
The backstop in main.ts is an unref'd 10 s exit(1).
The candidate's SIGTERM test (src/main.ts exits 0 within the grace with a stalled upload) passes in both integration runs. The policy is documented in docs/operations/health-readiness.md: in-flight requests longer than 5 s are cut.

checks_run.procedure: Probe R4 (signed-in session, limit 6/min, SPA webRoot) and R4b (anonymous, limit 5/min). Check for double metering, SPA fallback, CSRF and authorization behaviour, the 429 shape, and the /healthz exemption.
checks_run.expected: Each unmatched request counts once in the same bucket as the routes. The SPA fallback serves index.html until the limit. No CSRF or authorization bypass, and no state change. Every 429 is the rate_limited problem with security headers.
checks_run.actual:
R4b (one IP bucket): spa 200, unmatched GET/POST/HEAD 404, matched /me 401, with remaining 4, 3, 2, 1, 0 (exactly one count each). Then the unmatched route, the SPA and /me all get 429 rate_limited with CSP and Retry-After 60, and /healthz still gets 200.
R4: the bucket key is the validated session subject once resolved, else the IP (F-DG1-142 design). Each bucket decrements once per request. An unmatched POST without CSRF is 404, and 0 audit events are added. Every response carries CSP, nosniff and X-Request-Id.

checks_run.procedure: Probe R6a-e, one fresh instance per case, attributing error-level logs to each case: a stalled JSON body, stalled headers and a stalled upload (requestTimeoutMs 1500), and client aborts of a JSON body and of an upload
checks_run.expected: 408 and close for each stall, no error-level log, nothing stored; an abort leaves no error log
checks_run.actual: Finding F-DG2-412 (Low, not mandatory). R6a (stalled JSON body) gets 408 and close correctly, but one level-50 'unhandled error' line follows (aborted, ECONNRESET, statusCode 400, mapped to 500). R6d (JSON body aborted by the client) produces the same line at both candidates. R6b, R6c and R6e give 408 or close with no error log. At 7fd1a89c R6e also logged 'unhandled error': BE16 fixed that for the upload route only.

checks_run.procedure: Probe R8 and R8b. One authorized user opens 6 stalled uploads to 6 distinct items (harness pool max 5). Then another user calls GET /api/v1/me and GET /readyz. R8b repeats this with requestTimeoutMs 3000.
checks_run.expected: Stalled request bodies do not exhaust shared database capacity
checks_run.actual: Finding F-DG2-411 (Medium, not mandatory). With the uploads stalled, /me and /readyz get no answer within 5 s (5,001-5,002 ms). After the sockets are destroyed, /me returns 200 in 19-22 ms. The result is the same at 7fd1a89c. R8b on this candidate: all 6 uploads get 408, and /me returns 200 at about 3.1 s, so the hold equals requestTimeout (default 300 s). At 7fd1a89c it was unbounded (/me still blocked at 15 s). Cause: the upload handler takes a pooled connection and the row lock before reading the body (routes.ts:421-464). The pool max is 20, with no checkout timeout.

abortedBodyProblem maps only request.raw.aborted or ECONNRESET to 400. With the filesystem-only store, ECONNRESET can come only from the request stream.

ADR-0007 §5b now lists the unmatched-route 429 as out of contract, consistent with R4/R4b.
